code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, and mild neutropenia, with elevated basophils and mildly increased creatinine. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible infection, or systemic disease. The low ALT is not clinically significant. Renal function should be monitored. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
